name: tedtoolkit-hyperframes-tutorials
description: Plan, resume, script, edit narration, storyboard, produce, validate, and package animated HyperFrames tutorials.

interface.longDescription: File-based workflows for planning and resuming tutorial courses, detecting stale artifacts, writing scripts, editing narration, designing final-audio-aligned storyboards, producing HyperFrames videos, and packaging verified offline learner releases.
defaultPrompt: Plan a coherent animated tutorial course with stable lesson workspaces.
Resume a partially produced course from its verified state and detect stale artifacts.
Turn an approved script and raw recording into a verified narration master.
Storyboard and produce a lesson against its final narration timing.
